official_wall_text: 优秀历史建筑／新场镇新场大街169–173号（单号）／江南传统民居。1931年竣工，砖木结构。／上海市人民政府2015年8月17日公布
visible_construction: Four separately framed leaves. The two central meeting edges stand forward of the outer pair. The upper lights carry rectilinear fretwork and an isolated central purple square. All four lower timber panels have a nested frame and corner leaves. A fixed granite step and rounded upright stones border the entrance.
chronology: The plaque describes completion of the registered building in 1931. It supplies no construction date for the current doors. The separately reported property at 210 is outside this numbered entrance.
physical_scale: 据2023年7月4日已刊实照。四扇门名义合宽约2米，门扇厚度、门枕背面及中扇开启角约7.5度与10度为图像估计。铭牌记载该幢房屋完工于1931年，现存门料及玻璃的安装年代待查。
